# Licensing and provenance

This is a Fortran translation of the computational core of the R package
`DEoptim` version 2.2-8.

The original package DESCRIPTION declares:

    License: GPL (>= 2)

Accordingly this translation is distributed under the GNU General Public
License, version 2 or (at your option) any later version. Copies of GPL-2 and
GPL-3 are included as `LICENSE-GPL-2` and `LICENSE-GPL-3`.

The translated differential-evolution engine is based on
`src/de4_0.c`, whose header states that it is an implementation based loosely
on DE-Engine v4.0 by Rainer Storn (2004), implemented for DEoptim by Katharine
Mullen (2009), and modified by Joshua Ulrich (2010).

Original package metadata, C/R reference sources, CITATION, and THANKS are
retained under `original/` for attribution and provenance. Those files are not
compiled by FPM.
